name: Somalia
summary_text: Somalia is a place trans visitors should avoid entirely — one of the world's most dangerous countries for any LGBT person. The Penal Code criminalises same-sex conduct (up to 3 years), but the operative reality is worse: Al-Shabaab controls significant territory and applies its interpretation of sharia, under which homosexuality and gender transgression are capital offences — executions are documented. Even in government areas, mob violence and clan-justice dynamics make any gender nonconformity lethal-risk. There is no legal gender recognition, no community, and no recourse of any kind. For a visitor: there is no safe way to be visibly trans anywhere in Somalia.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust country profile documents Somalia's criminalisation of same-sex sexual activity (up to life imprisonment under the 1964 penal code; death penalty under Sharia in some regions).

US State Department 2021 Human Rights Report for Somalia: official assessment - same-sex conduct criminalised (up to 3 years); al-Shabaab enforces strict Sharia with death as possible punishment; pervasive violence and statelessness.

sources.title: Somalia - United States Department of State
sources.claim_summary: US State Department 2022 Human Rights Report for Somalia: official assessment - continued criminalisation, al-Shabaab executions, and no protections for LGBT persons.

US State Department 2010 Human Rights Report for Somalia (archived): documents the conflict, al-Shabaab abuses, and the LGBT section noting criminalisation and the death penalty under Islamic law in areas under insurgent control.

sources.title: Report: Somalia too risky for LGBT people
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes (Feb 2016): legal advocate Benjamin Christman's report 'on the Treatment of Gay Persons in Somalia' sustains asylum claims - beyond the 3-year anti-homosexuality law, al-Shabaab's Sharia enforcement may punish homosexuality by death; UN and UK guidance identifies gay persons as a 'risk profile' for return.

sources.title: Gay Somali refugees face death threats | Features | Al Jazeera
sources.claim_summary: Al Jazeera (July 2013): 'Gay Somali refugees face death threats' - gay, lesbian and HIV-infected refugees in Kenya face persecution if returned; Jamal, a Somali journalist: 'Warlords have made Somalia a death chamber for gays and lesbians'; Said Elmi: 'It will be a massacre.'
